mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over a 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is indicative of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over a 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is likely to boost equity markets, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over a 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances over a 2-year period.
